sentences.text:
Thereafter Sectgions 406/417/418/465 ... vs In Re: Mr. Jahir
Abbas Khan on 7 October, 2024
Author: Soumen Sen
Bench: Soumen Sen 07.10.2024 Court No.29 Item No. 102  Rejected

ar  CRM (A) 3670 of 2024  In Re:- An application for anticipatory bail under Section 438 of the Cod  Criminal Procedure corresponding to Section 482 of the Bharatiya Nagarik  Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 in connection with Shakespear Sarani Police Statio  Case No. 14 of 2024 dated 18.01.2024 corresponding to G.R Case No. 71 of  2024 under Sections 120B/408/420/468/471 of the Indian Penal Code and  thereafter Sectgions 406/417/418/465 of the Indian Penal Code.
 And  In Re: Mr. Jahir Abbas Khan  Petitioner  Mr. Apan Saha  Mr. Subhadip Dhara  Mr. Subhashis Jana For the Petitioner  Ms. Rituparna Ghosh  Mr. Bikram Mitra For the State  1.
Heard the learned counsel appearing for the parties.

2. Considering the materials available in the case diary, the nature and extent of complicity of the petitioner in the commission of the alleged offence and having regard to the fact that there are incriminating materials found in the case diary disclosing the involvement of the petitioner in mis- appropriation of fund in respect of 62 customers and it involves substantial amount and the investigation is still continuing, we are not inclined to grant anticipatory bail to the petitioner.
3. Accordingly, the prayer for anticipatory bail of the petitioner is rejected and the same is accordingly disposed of.
4. All parties shall act on the server copies of this order duly downloaded from the official website of this Court.

(Soumen Sen, J) (Uday Kumar, J)
